user.title: Neon Hub
user.description: Connect to a Neon Hub to use its voice assistant, speech, and LLM services in Home Assistant.

data_description.host: Hostname or full address (including the scheme) of the hub's HANA API, e.g. the hana alias advertised by the hub.
data_description.username: Hub user account for Home Assistant to authenticate as.
data_description.password: Password for the hub user account.
data_description.verify_ssl: Disabled by default because Neon Hub ships with a self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate with Neon Hub
reauth_confirm.description: The hub rejected the stored credentials. Enter valid credentials to continue.

data_description.username: Hub user account for Home Assistant to authenticate as.
data_description.password: Password for the hub user account.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Neon Hub
reconfigure.description: Update the connection settings for your Neon Hub.

data_description.host: Hostname or full address (including the scheme) of the hub's HANA API.
data_description.username: Hub user account for Home Assistant to authenticate as.
data_description.password: Password for the hub user account.
data_description.verify_ssl: Disabled by default because Neon Hub ships with a self-signed certificate.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Neon Hub. Verify the host is correct and the hub is running.
error.invalid_auth: The hub rejected the username or password.

abort.already_configured: This Neon Hub is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the discovered Neon Hub.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The hub at this address reports a different hub identity than the one originally configured.

data_description.llm_backend: Which hub LLM endpoint the LLM conversation agent queries. The backend must be deployed on your hub.
data_description.tts_gender: Preferred voice gender for speech synthesis.
data_description.language: BCP-47 style language code used for speech services, e.g. en-us.

cannot_connect.message: Unable to reach the Neon Hub at {base_url}.

synthesize_failed.message: The Neon Hub failed to synthesize speech.
